papers.title: Multiscale Policy Optimization for Long-Horizon LLM Agents
papers.desc: Long-horizon LLM agents interact with their environments through complete assistant turns while generating each action token by token.

papers.title: VibeVideoBench: Evaluating Multimodal Agents on Code-Driven Video Generation
papers.desc: Diffusion video models produce striking clips, but they cannot reliably render an exact formula, a correct chart, a rule-consistent game or narration synchronized to on-screen events.

papers.title: Can Discrete Tokens Serve as Semantically Lossless Representations of Visual Signals?
papers.desc: Discrete visual tokens represent vision in a discrete form analogous to language, offering a native interface for multimodal modeling under a shared next-token prediction objective.

papers.title: Truncate or Not? A Scaling Study of Looped Transformers with Truncated Backpropagation
papers.desc: Looped transformers reuse a shared block of layers to increase computational depth without increasing the number of trainable parameters.

papers.title: Zooming without Zooming v2: From Seeing Details to Connecting Evidence for Generalizable Multimodal Perception
papers.desc: Multimodal perception forms the foundation of multimodal intelligence.

papers.title: h1: A Taste of the Bitter Lesson in Automated Theorem Proving
papers.desc: While progress in informal mathematics has come largely from scaling the chain-of-thought and agentic reasoning of frontier language models, formal theorem proving has increasingly relied on human-designed workflows around these models, such as planning, decomposition, and orchestrating specialized provers.

papers.title: EmbeddingGemma 2: Unified and Efficient Multimodal Representations
papers.desc: We present EmbeddingGemma 2, an open multimodal embedding model which natively represents text, images, audio, video, and combinations thereof in a unified space.

papers.title: RynnWorld-Latent: A Cross-Embodiment World Model Conditioned on Universal Latent Actions
papers.desc: Learning controllable world dynamics from heterogeneous interaction videos is challenging because robot embodiments use incompatible action spaces, while human videos lack native control labels.

papers.title: Beyond the Estimate: Wiener-Informed Decoding for Easier Training of Pixel-Space Flow Models
papers.desc: Learning velocity fields directly in pixel space is difficult and slow.

papers.title: The Lexical Imprint of Pre-training Data
papers.desc: How much of zero-shot benchmark accuracy is captured by word-level alignment between a pre-training corpus and the benchmark target? We study this question through word-level unigram cross-entropy (UCE), a tokenizer-agnostic, model-free measure of lexical alignment between a reference corpus and a target benchmark.

papers.title: Rare, Relevant, and Still Wrong: How Memory Fails LLM Group Decisions
papers.desc: When an LLM group's discussion is compressed into a short memory for a final decision maker, what should the memory keep? Two natural heuristics keep the rarest claims or the claims relevant to the decision criteria.

papers.title: What Outcome RL Buys: Finishing, Reliability, Rarely Reach
papers.desc: Outcome RL raises pass@1 but not pass@k at large k (Yue et al., 2025).

papers.title: How Much Does the Hint Matter? Scope Conditions for Hindsight Self-Distillation in Financial Reasoning
papers.desc: Financial institutions operating under data-residency constraints are restricted to open-weight models small enough to locally host, which trail frontier systems on multi-step quantitative reasoning.

papers.title: T-DIG: Text-Conditioned Diversity for Image Generation
papers.desc: Text-to-image (T2I) platforms typically return several images per prompt so users can explore different visual interpretations and choose one that matches their intent.

papers.title: Lipi-Ghor: A Large-Scale, Diarized, Multi-Domain Bengali Speech Corpus and a Scalable Pipeline for Building It
papers.desc: Bengali, spoken by over 230 million people, remains severely under-resourced in spoken language research.
